request.deadline: Instantly performed as part of the governance action's enactment on-chain
deliverables: Instant on-chain treasury withdrawal to reimburse a 100000 ADA lost deposit
Additional 3000 ADA compensation for estimated lost staking rewards
request.what: Reimburse the Ikigai Info governance action submitter for an unrecovered governance action deposit and estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai - was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering a 100000 ADA deposit.
The proposal requests 103000 ADA, consisting of the original 100000 ADA deposit plus 3000 ADA for lost staking rewards at 2% per annum.
The proposer says there was significant community sentiment that the Ikigai deposit should be reimbursed because the submitter was an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in a budget Info governance action, but that action was not approved.
The proposer states the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposer states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal provides an external Adastat governance reference for the prior governance action.
The proposer says no administrator custody, audits, oversight budget, or refund circumstances are needed because funds will be directly distributed on-chain to the intended recipient.

summary: The document requests 103000 ADA to reimburse an unrecovered Ikigai Info governance action deposit and estimated staking rewards, but most material assertions are proposer-stated with only one external governance reference and no recipient identity in the anchor text.
